gen-gf-handlee-archivo: Handlee writes in tightly gathered, hand-drawn letters, while Archivo, a sans, opens its curves outward and stands commanding in the lowercase. Handlee is most welcome in a large title, never a long one.
gen-gf-handlee-fs-epilogue: Beneath the hand-drawn Handlee heading, the text letters are curvy, wire-thin and unclamped. Epilogue feels made for a quick page rather than an endless scroll, friendly and modern throughout.
gen-gf-handlee-fs-merriweather-sans: Casual meets sturdy: Handlee scrawls tightly gathered letters on top, while Merriweather Sans sets large-looking lowercase with a clearly open e. Hand-drawn warmth against sturdy words is the draw, better when text stays short.
gen-gf-handlee-montserrat: Handlee gathers its letters tightly, with a hand-drawn feel. Use it on a few large words, then let Montserrat, a geometric sans with oversized counters, glide along where paragraphs stay short.
gen-gf-handlee-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern, its c tips holding well apart and each curve as sturdy as a stem. And the casual hand of Handlee is the draw, better when the text stays brief.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-epunda-slab: Happy Monkey draws every line ruler-straight, with wide gaps in the e that make it bold and distinctive. But Epunda Slab, dignified and rounded, does the quieter work, its gaping c staying readable at any size.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary, with shallow ascenders and a generous e. Beside it, Happy Monkey comes in bold and ruler-straight, with no swelling in its bowls, a shout set against a murmur.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-hanuman: Hanuman sits high-waisted and refined, with wide-set terminals on its s. Happy Monkey's bold, ruler-straight lines, with no thinning anywhere, set against that traditional restraint, are the real draw.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-kadwa: Happy Monkey bends its letterforms like tubing, bold and distinctive, with a moderate lowercase height. And Kadwa rises higher in the lowercase, editorial and open-ended, a measured counterpart to all that bent tubing.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-suwannaphum: Happy Monkey draws bold, ruler-straight strokes with wide gaps in the e, edges running parallel through every curve. Suwannaphum, high-reaching and dignified, would carry a stretch of text with an open c and a squared-off, editorial look.
